annotations.title: Book a free call with Nikita

description: Books a free 30-minute video call with Nikita Marushkov at one of the times from find_call_times. The call goes on Nikita's calendar, and Google Calendar emails the user an invite with the Google Meet link; the result also has a link to cancel. It books the call only. Call it once, after the user has seen the exact time in their own time zone and their contact details and agreed.

about.description: What the user wants to talk about, in a sentence or two, in their own words.

email.description: The user's email address, where the invite goes.

phone.description: Optional: the user's phone number, if they want Nikita to call or text them about this call. It isn't put in the invite.

start.description: The exact start from find_call_times, copied as is with its time zone offset, e.g. "2026-11-04T14:00:00-05:00".

time_zone.description: Optional: the user's time zone, e.g. America/Chicago, to show the time in it.
